name: Email a weekly accounts-receivable ageing report from Invoice Ninja with PDFMint

parameters.content:
## Weekly accounts-receivable ageing report from Invoice Ninja

One landscape PDF that shows who owes you what and how late it is, mailed to yourself every Monday. Add Invoice Ninja, PDFMint and Gmail credentials, then edit **Your company details**.

PDFMint is a community node: install `n8n-nodes-pdfmint` from Settings → Community nodes first.

### 1 · Schedule
Runs every Monday at 08:00, before the week's chasing starts.

### 2 · Branding
Set your company name, address, accent colour, currency and the address the report goes to. This is the only node you edit.

### 3 · Invoice Ninja
Fetches every active invoice with the client record included, so the report can name clients rather than ids.

### 4 · Ageing
Keeps invoices with a balance still owed and buckets each one by days past its due date: not yet due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+.

### 5 · Guard
Stops cleanly when nothing is outstanding, so no empty report is mailed and no PDF credit is spent.

### 6 · PDF
Renders the branded ageing table with PDFMint and names the file after the report date.

### 7 · Delivery
Emails the PDF to the address you set in step 2. Swap this node for Slack or Drive if you prefer.
